sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1971
ORDINANCE XXXIII
OF 1971
DETENTION OF ENEMY
SHIPS, AIRCRAFT AND GOODS ORDINANCE, 1971
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 8th December 1971]
No. F. 24(1)/71-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 7th December 1971, is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Detention of Enemy
Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 3rd day of December 1971.

sections.shortTitle: Detention of Enemy Ships Aircraft and Goods Ordinance 1971
sections.description:
Detention of enemy ships, aircraft and goods

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1971
ORDINANCE XXXIII
OF 1971
DETENTION OF ENEMY
SHIPS, AIRCRAFT AND GOODS ORDINANCE, 1971
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 8th December 1971]
No. F. 24(1)/71-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 7th December 1971, is hereby
published for general information :-
2. Detention of enemy ships,
aircraft and goods.-(1) No enemy ship or enemy aircraft, and no enemy goods
in transit by any means, whatever, shall be allowed to depart from, or be taken
out of Pakistan, and all such ships and aircraft and all such goods shall be
detained and shall be taken as prize, and the law relating to prize shall apply
in relation to such goods as it applies in relation to enemy ships and enemy
aircraft and goods carried therein.
(2) All goods detained under
subsection (1), other than the goods the importation or exportation of which to
and from Pakistan is prohibited by or under any law for the time being in force
or which can be taken as prize in accordance with the law relating to prize,
shall be released to the owner thereof or person entitled thereto.
(3) Every enemy ship or enemy
aircraft detained under subsection (1) shall together with all goods carried
therein the release of which is not required by subsection (2), be brought
before the Prize Court forthwith for adjudication.
(4) For the removal of doubts, it
is hereby declared that, in this Ordinance, "ship" includes every
description of vessels, boats and crafts, whether sea-going or ordinarily
plying on inland waters, with the tackle, furniture and apparel of the ship,
vessel, boat or craft.
